ck: (2)petasancivini sankapiprayanaviskrtya nirakaroti vyaktyapetopiti satyapavasanteha iti svarasikasanteha ityarta ahitastu pavatyeva sa ca prakrte nastyeva tasya paranarsatO aprananyasankanulakatvat tesan ca prakrtenukulatarkapayenanutiteriti pava tarnikrahakananeneti saptarupakunasrayataya kakanasya siti tatra prtivyaticatustayakalpane kOravapratisantanenEko vipurakasa sityati evanitanin kata ityatipratitisu taraniparispanto katatinan sanpantakatakataya lakavateko vipu kala sityati iha kata ityatipratitinirvahaya nurtasanpantakatakataya latavateka vipurtik sityati tatra catyankikare nanakakanatipraptya tasya tarnikrahakananapatatityarta na cetityartantaranityanena sanpanta
s: (२२)भेदसञ्जीविनी शङ्काभिप्रायमाविष्कृत्य निराकरोति व्यक्त्यभेदोऽपीति साध्याभावसन्देह इति स्वारसिकसन्देह इत्यर्थः आहितस्तु भवत्येव स च प्रकृत
